mapper.insert: insert into job (company_id, category_id, title, description, requirement, salary_min, salary_max, city, education, tags, status, view_count, apply_count, deadline, source_url, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{companyId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{requirement}, #{salaryMin}, #{salaryMax}, #{city}, #{education}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{viewCount}, #{applyCount}, #{deadline}, #{sourceUrl}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
select j.*, c.name companyName, k.name categoryName from job j left join company c on j.company_id = c.id left join job_category k on j.category_id = k.id
and j.category_id = #{categoryId} and j.status = #{status}
and j.city like concat('%', #{city}, '%')
and j.education like concat('%', #{education}, '%')
and ( j.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') or j.requirement like concat('%', #{title}, '%') or j.description like concat('%', #{title}, '%') or c.name like concat('%', #{title}, '%') )
order by case when j.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') then 0 when j.requirement like concat('%', #{title}, '%') then 1 when c.name like concat('%', #{title}, '%') then 2 else 3 end, j.create_time desc
order by j.create_time desc
